candidates.title: The Unequal Market Scales
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the market scales gave different weights for identical sacks before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they changed the weighing pans but the readings still differed; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized one leg of the table rested on a loose floorboard; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they leveled the table and recalibrated the scales with standard weights, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Radio That Worked Only at Dusk
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the hilltop radio failed each afternoon before returning at dusk before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they changed its battery but reception stayed poor; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a rotating metal wind vane blocked the antenna at certain angles; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they relocated the antenna and verified reception through the afternoon, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Vanishing Platform Number
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered travelers kept arriving at the wrong railway platform before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they repainted the signs but confusion continued; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a glass advertisement reflected the platform numeral in reverse; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they turned the advertisement panel and checked sightlines from the entrance, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
